chunks: Ibrāhīm ibn Abī Yaḥyā al-Madanī narrated from him, peace be upon him, that he said:
"There is no harm in setting out on a journey on the night of Friday."

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to set out on a journey on the night of Friday?
ai.summary: This hadith states that there is no objection to beginning travel on the night of Friday. It indicates permissibility regarding the timing of departure and clarifies that such travel is not considered problematic.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2390 - Ibrahim ibn Abi Yahya al-Madani narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as):
"There is no harm in setting out on a journey on the night of Friday."
